title: Reactive sputtered Zn3N2–CNx hybrid films for silicon heterojunction photodetection
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22587-22599
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02403C, Paper

Ali J. Addie, Raid A. Ismail, Azhar I. Hassan, Mudhafar A. Mohammed
Reactive sputtered Zn3N2–CNx hybrid films modify carrier transport and junction electrostatics on p-Si. The hybrid heterojunction exhibits improved rectification, higher responsivity and detectivity, and fast transient photoresponse.
